newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details rail car unloads at export position.
newsitem.headline: CWB details rail car unloads at export position.

text.p: All rail car unloads of Prairie grains and oilseeds at export position fell short of targetted allocations in the week ended December 8, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
Rail car unloads at Vancouver reached 2,618 cars, below the 3,400 target, the CWB said.
Unloads at Prince Rupert totalled 1,231, below the 1,500 target, it said.
Thunder Bay unloads reached 2,805 railcars, below the 3,200 target, the CWB said.
